meta.summary: ataqv 1.3.1 for ATAC-seq alignment QC, peak and TSS metrics, and offline interactive result visualization.
meta.description: ataqv 1.3.1 for ATAC-seq alignment QC, peak and TSS metrics, and offline interactive result visualization.

test: { ataqv --version 2>&1 || true; } | grep -Fx '1.3.1' >/dev/null && { ataqv --help 2>&1 || true; } | grep -F 'QC metrics for ATAC-seq data' >/dev/null && mkarv --version | grep -Fx '1.3.1' >/dev/null && mkarv --help | grep -F 'Given one or more ataqv metrics files' >/dev/null && srvarv --help | grep -F 'serve an instance of the ataqv web results viewer' >/dev/null && ataqv-viewer --help | grep -F 'foreground browser service' >/dev/null && python -c 'import argparse,collections,csv,decimal,functools,gzip,http.server,json,multiprocessing,shutil,socketserver' && ! ldd $(command -v ataqv) | grep -F 'not found'

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ataqv-core-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; cp /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/test.bam /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/test.peaks.gz "$tmp/"; cd "$tmp"; ataqv --ignore-read-groups --name smoke-core --peak-file test.peaks.gz --metrics-file metrics.json human test.bam > summary.txt; python -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert len(d)==1; m=d[0]["metrics"]; assert m["name"]=="smoke-core"; assert m["total_reads"]==1040; assert m["hqaa"]==400; assert m["total_peaks"]==37430; assert m["hqaa_in_peaks"]==120' metrics.json; test -s summary.txt

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ataqv-tss-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; cp /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/test.bam /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/test.bam.bai /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/test.peaks.gz /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/hg19.tss.refseq.bed.gz /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/exclude.dac.bed.gz /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/exclude.duke.bed.gz "$tmp/"; cd "$tmp"; ataqv --threads 2 --peak-file test.peaks.gz --tss-file hg19.tss.refseq.bed.gz --excluded-region-file exclude.dac.bed.gz --excluded-region-file exclude.duke.bed.gz --metrics-file metrics.json.gz human test.bam > summary.txt; gzip -t metrics.json.gz; python -c 'import gzip,json,sys; d=json.load(gzip.open(sys.argv[1],"rt")); assert len(d)==2; vals=[x["metrics"]["tss_enrichment"] for x in d]; assert all(v is not None for v in vals); assert any(abs(v-6.0)<1e-9 for v in vals)' metrics.json.gz; test -s summary.txt

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ataqv-custom-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; cp /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/test.bam "$tmp/"; cd "$tmp"; printf 'chr1\nchr2\n' > autosomes.txt; ataqv --ignore-read-groups --name smoke-custom --autosomal-reference-file autosomes.txt --mitochondrial-reference-name chrM --log-problematic-reads --less-redundant --metrics-file custom.json human test.bam > summary.txt; python -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); m=d[0]["metrics"]; assert m["name"]=="smoke-custom"; assert m["total_autosomal_reads"]==435; assert m["total_mitochondrial_reads"]==369' custom.json; find . -type f -name '*.problems' -size +0c -print -quit | grep -q .

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ataqv-mkarv-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; mkarv --less-redundant --description 'TAFFISH smoke viewer' "$tmp/viewer" /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/smoke-basic.ataqv.json.gz > "$tmp/mkarv.log" 2>&1; test -s "$tmp/viewer/index.html"; test -s "$tmp/viewer/js/configuration.js"; test -s "$tmp/viewer/css/ataqv.css"; grep -F 'TAFFISH smoke viewer' "$tmp/viewer/js/configuration.js" >/dev/null; find "$tmp/viewer/data" -type f -name '*.json.gz' -size +0c -print -quit | grep -q .

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ataqv-srvarv-$$; pid=; trap 'test -z "$pid" || kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp/viewer"; printf 'ataqv-srvarv-ok\n' > "$tmp/viewer/index.html"; PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 srvarv -p 8765 "$tmp/viewer" > "$tmp/server.log" 2>&1 & pid=$!; i=0; until python -c 'import urllib.request; assert urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8765/", timeout=1).read()==b"ataqv-srvarv-ok\n"' 2>/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); test "$i" -lt 30; sleep 1; done; kill -TERM "$pid"; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; pid=; grep -F 'Serving ataqv web viewer instance' "$tmp/server.log" >/dev/null

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ataqv-error-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; if ataqv human "$tmp/missing.bam" > "$tmp/error.txt" 2>&1; then exit 1; fi; grep -F 'The specified alignment file does not exist.' "$tmp/error.txt" >/dev/null

test -s /opt/ataqv/share/doc/ataqv/README.rst && test -s /opt/ataqv/share/licenses/ataqv/LICENSE && test -s /opt/ataqv/share/licenses/ataqv/COPYRIGHT && test -s /opt/ataqv/share/provenance/debian-packages.tsv && grep -Fx 'upstream_commit=15686234e707c3d779a8e45f39a390c29a8691f5' /opt/ataqv/share/provenance/source.txt >/dev/null && echo 'e286d521919d8117aad8b6aaf91d0539212d8c5fcc1bd33be26d435ef8b58dd3  /opt/ataqv/share/source/ataqv/ataqv-1.3.1.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ataqv-viewer-$$; pid=; trap 'test -z "$pid" || kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; mkarv --less-redundant --description 'TAFFISH service smoke' "$tmp/viewer" /opt/ataqv/share/testdata/smoke-basic.ataqv.json.gz > "$tmp/mkarv.log" 2>&1; test -s "$tmp/viewer/index.html"; ataqv-viewer --port 8765 --host-port 18765 --url-host 127.0.0.1 --bind-address 127.0.0.1 --startup-timeout 20 --log-file "$tmp/http.log" "$tmp/viewer" > "$tmp/user.log" 2>&1 & pid=$!; i=0; until python -c 'import urllib.request; page=urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8765/", timeout=1).read(); assert b"ataqv results viewer" in page' 2>/dev/null && grep -F 'ataqv viewer is ready.' "$tmp/user.log" >/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); test "$i" -lt 30; sleep 1; done; grep -F 'http://127.0.0.1:18765/' "$tmp/user.log" >/dev/null; grep -F 'ssh -N -L 18765:127.0.0.1:18765 user@server' "$tmp/user.log" >/dev/null; grep -F 'Press Ctrl-C to stop this viewer session.' "$tmp/user.log" >/dev/null; grep -F 'ataqv viewer is ready.' "$tmp/user.log" >/dev/null; ! grep -F '"GET / HTTP' "$tmp/user.log" >/dev/null; grep -F '"GET / HTTP' "$tmp/http.log" >/dev/null; kill -TERM "$pid"; status=0; wait "$pid" || status=$?; pid=; test "$status" -eq 143

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-ataqv-viewer-input-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp/empty"; status=0; ataqv-viewer "$tmp/missing" > "$tmp/missing.log" 2>&1 || status=$?; test "$status" -eq 2; grep -F 'viewer directory does not exist' "$tmp/missing.log" >/dev/null; grep -F 'mkarv VIEWER_DIRECTORY METRICS.json[.gz] [...]' "$tmp/missing.log" >/dev/null; status=0; ataqv-viewer "$tmp/empty" > "$tmp/empty.log" 2>&1 || status=$?; test "$status" -eq 2; grep -F 'viewer directory has no nonempty index.html' "$tmp/empty.log" >/dev/null; grep -F 'mkarv VIEWER_DIRECTORY METRICS.json[.gz] [...]' "$tmp/empty.log" >/dev/null

upstream.name: ataqv
upstream.citation: Orchard P et al. Quantification, Dynamic Visualization, and Validation of Bias in ATAC-Seq Data with ataqv. Cell Systems 10(3), 2020.
